  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Great (OE grēat) = thick, coarse; Exuma (Lucayan Arawak) = 'land of the little sea' or 'east'",
    "reading": "The thick land of the little sea — a dense, salt-rimmed mass rising from shallow waters.",
    "languages": ["en", "aiw"],
    "source": "OED; Granberry & Vescelius, 'Languages of the Pre-Columbian Antilles'",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Great + Exuma → 'great' = grand, 'ex' = out, 'uma' = mother (Lat. umbra? or 'huma' earth)",
    "reading": "Out of the great mother — a birth of land from the sea's womb, a primal emergence.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Exuma → 'ex huma' (Lat. ex humo = from the ground); 'great' → 'grata' (It. pleasing)",
    "reading": "Pleasing from the ground — a land that rises to delight, rooted in the earth's favour.",
    "languages": ["la", "it", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Great Exuma → 'exu magarte' → 'exu' (Yoruba trickster) + 'magarte' (anagram of 'great am'?)",
    "reading": "The trickster's great 'I am' — a playful, shape-shifting identity hidden in the name.",
    "languages": ["yo", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "G.E. → 'G' = gamma (Greek) = generation; 'E' = epsilon = emptiness; combined: generation from void",
    "reading": "Genesis from the void — the first letter pair encodes a cosmogonic act, land from nothing.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "G = 7 (completion), E = 5 (quintessence), X = 24 (omega), U = 21 (crown), M = 13 (death), A = 1 (unity)",
    "reading": "Seven and five, twenty-four and twenty-one, thirteen and one — a ladder of completion, essence, end, crown, death, unity.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "Crowley, '777'; Agrippa, 'Three Books of Occult Philosophy'",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Great Exuma → G(7)+R(18)+E(5)+A(1)+T(20) = 51; E(5)+X(24)+U(21)+M(13)+A(1) = 64; 51+64 = 115",
    "reading": "115 reduces to 7 (1+1+5) — the number of rest, completion, and the sabbath of the land.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Great Exuma → 'grey t' + 'exuma' → 'grey' (colour of ash) + 'ex' (out) + 'uma' (mother)",
    "reading": "Ash-grey out of the mother — a burnt, ancient crust left after a fiery birth.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
